disposition: retain the design expertise but revise authority, network, cost, live-mode, provider, evidence, and licensing boundaries before promotion

invocation.boundaries: planning and review remain read-only; project writes, processes, harness configuration, external network, credentials, paid calls, local agents, installation, and publication require matching authority

execution.recommended: in-session for small read-only or bounded project-edit work

changes.summary: Record these pre-existing tracked candidate-source modifications as a preservation failure. They were not authored, repaired, approved, or validated as implementation by the final-handoff work and must be excluded from the proposed review-artifact change.

Add the candidate review and machine-readable contract, grounded in the frozen inventory and HEAD baseline, with the five-file preservation failure and worktree-dependent question-token limitation disclosed.

questions.question: Should one general Impeccable invocation authorize every Bash and Node capability in the tree?
questions.recommendation: No; separate read, project-write, process, harness-config, external-network, credential, paid-call, and local-agent capabilities, and require request-level authority or inline confirmation for each material escalation.
questions.rationale: The exposed branches range from read-only review to persistent source/config mutation, servers, agents, network calls, and paid generation.

questions.question: May mandatory setup perform version checks, and may concept selection send roll or choice telemetry by default?
questions.recommendation: Make choice telemetry opt-in and disclose endpoint, fields, owner, retention, timeout, cache writes, and offline fallback before network contact; keep version checks separately disableable.
questions.rationale: The baseline performs external requests in setup and concept selection without a complete privacy and consent contract in the frozen tree.

questions.question: May availability of OPENAI_API_KEY make a multi-image generation round mandatory?
questions.recommendation: No; require explicit cost and credential-use confirmation before the first paid call and retain a no-image or code-led route.
questions.rationale: Credential availability does not establish authority to incur cost or transmit prompts.

questions.question: Should live mode be promoted as part of ordinary design execution?
questions.recommendation: Retain it only as an advanced explicit command with process/file/network/agent preflight, bounded roots, rollback receipts, and deterministic cleanup.
questions.rationale: Live mode starts services, injects framework code, mutates source, and can spawn coding agents; ordinary design invocation is insufficient authority.

questions.question: Is the Claude allowed-tools and degraded-agent packaging contract verified for this exact tree and portable to other harnesses?
questions.recommendation: Keep this variant Claude-specific until provider fixtures prove permissions, named-agent availability, invocation names, and metadata behavior.
questions.rationale: Cross-provider references do not establish equivalent enforcement or packaging.

questions.question: Is the Apache-2.0 frontmatter declaration sufficient for redistribution of this full tree and bundled third-party code?
questions.recommendation: Require authoritative license text plus applicable third-party notices and version-matched provenance before promotion.
questions.rationale: No license file was discovered in bounded ancestry, and the tree includes a vendored browser bundle.
